composition_elements.framing: vertical high-resolution studio fashion portrait centered on the subject

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-resolution photorealistic studio fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman with long light brown hair with golden blonde highlights in loose curls. Give her a playful, cheeky thinking expression while she looks off to the side with relaxed shoulders. She wears a gold shimmering party hat and a gold sequin party dress with a modern asymmetric neckline cutout. She holds gold foil balloons shaped as numbers 20 and 26, one in each hand raised near her shoulders. Use a clean neutral beige studio background, soft approximately 5000K key light with gentle shadows, visible skin texture, detailed hair strands, sharp sequin detail, and metallic balloons with realistic creases, reflections, and highlights. Keep the image editorial-quality, photorealistic, clean, and free of text, logos, branding, and watermarks.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike styling, real logo, branding, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, melted balloons, broken number shapes, distorted sequins
